note: The pin LonFinkMars names the March column of a merged monthly family. A 2018-01..2018-03 request is ordered for 2018-03 alone, with one clip. Moved from `api/validate-merged-monthly-family` when `validate` dropped `range_period_partially_covered` (#1836). Fails if the order stops clipping each binding to these days, reports another clip, or renders a clipped period differently.
